title: Aligned Corpus Run Manifest
description: Pinned per-run state recorded at the start of an aligned-corpus run. The seed is initialized from UTC today_yyyymmdd() at run-start and re-read by every subsequent and resumed pipeline stage. Runtime enforcement compares any --seed argument to the recorded seed, never to wall-clock today.

run_id.description: Run identifier. Conventionally <YYYYMMDD>_<short-sha> but any non-empty string is accepted.

run_started_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recorded once at run-start.

seed.description: 8-digit YYYYMMDD seed, initialized from UTC today_yyyymmdd() at fresh run-start. Subsequent stages must read this value and not re-derive from wall-clock today.
